posts.author: Undermax
posts.body:
Hello everyone ,
Although I haven't posted much on these forums, I have had my account since 2013.
While I believe that incorporating new technologies and the idea of bringing everything together in one place are both positive initiatives, I do not think it was the right decision to remove a place that has accumulated so much content over many years from thousands of users around the world.
I believe that, as a serious company, you should absorb the cost of maintaining the forums, even if only in a "no new posts allowed" state. Requiring users to republish everything they wish to preserve seems like a truly absurd decision and, honestly, completely impractical.
To stay on topic with this thread, I am sharing my social media links below so that anyone can contact me if needed.
Best regards, and I wish you success in your projects!
